name: parasiter
description: Parasite SEO for affiliates in your AI assistant: find and analyze platforms, pick content that sells, write reviews, audit pages, create images, get pages indexed, analyze niches and affiliate programs, set goals and a daily plan, and keep a journal of pages, sales and checks.

parasiter_key.title: PARASITER key (Free, Pro or Insider)
parasiter_key.description: Your personal key from the PARASITER email (starts with psr_). Free key by email, no card: parasiter.affiliatecredo.com/free.html. Leave empty to use only the content skills. Kept in Claude Code's own settings on your computer (not the system keychain, which Claude Code updates can clear), sent only to the PARASITER server.

dataforseo_login.title: DataForSEO API login (optional)
dataforseo_login.description: Your own DataForSEO account for position checks, page keywords and platform scans (pay per request, cost shown before every run). app.dataforseo.com → API Access → API login. Leave empty if you don't use DataForSEO.

dataforseo_password.title: DataForSEO API password (optional)
dataforseo_password.description: API password from app.dataforseo.com → API Access (not your website password). Kept in Claude Code's own settings on your computer and sent only to api.dataforseo.com — never to the PARASITER server or the chat.

serpapi_key.title: SerpApi API key (optional)
serpapi_key.description: Your own SerpApi account, free plan 250 searches a month: position checks, platform scans and the search for new platforms (used before DataForSEO). serpapi.com → Your Account → API key. Kept in Claude Code's own settings on your computer and sent only to serpapi.com — never to the PARASITER server or the chat. Leave empty if you don't use SerpApi.
